LanguageData.FB_GasBladder.label: gas bladder
LanguageData.FB_GasBladder.description: A fragile fleshy bladder that absorbs one nearby gas type and bursts the stored cloud back out when struck.
LanguageData.FB_GasVent.label: gas vent
LanguageData.FB_GasVent.description: A small fleshy outlet that releases gas previously stored in colony gas bladders.
